stops.directionsToNext: Follow the hallway east, past the stairs, into the open hall.
Keep heading east through the open hall and the double doors.
EcoCar is just across the hallway, to your right.
Continue a few steps east. Formula Racing is beside the elevator.
Take the elevator beside Formula Racing, or the east stairs, up to the third floor. Room 3-26 is on your right as you head west.
Leave Room 3-26 and walk west along the main corridor.
Continue west to the end of the corridor, then turn right toward the central stairs.
Head west past the elevator. The rocketry team is in front of the elevator.
Walk back toward the central stairs. Engineers for a Sustainable World is beside AlbertaSat.
Go north past the stairs to the top of the hallway.
Turn left and head west. Room 3-10 is in the north-west corner.
That's the end of the tour. Use the west elevator or stairs to head back down.
